acceptance.link_forms_and_resolution: The shared fixture covers wiki and Markdown links, relative paths, spaces, aliases, headings, blocks, embeds, external links, unresolved targets and ambiguous duplicate headings/basenames. Document and confined VaultRoot/VaultSession resolver tests compare expected status, paths and candidates while preserving source bytes.
acceptance.rename_and_reference_updates: The rename fixture covers resolved wiki, Markdown and embed updates, BOM/CRLF/aliases/subpaths, same-basename disambiguation, duplicate headings, unresolved and ambiguous targets, exact post-apply bytes, transaction rollback, and native preview/review/confirmation interactions.
acceptance.transclusion_and_attachments: Snapshot-bound VaultSession note-embed resolution enforces Markdown-only targets, bounded reads, depth/cycle checks and report budgets; the native egui renderer displays formatted CommonMark and bounded static previews for BMP/GIF/ICO/JPEG/PNG/WebP. The UI interaction exercises actual vault file read/decode/render and unchanged attachment bytes.

accepted_validation.conclusion: All six required workflows passed; the workspace test suite exercised the complete link, rename and transclusion test set on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows.
accepted_validation.local_executable_validation: None; executable validation ran only in GitHub Actions.

limitations: Only supported static raster formats are previewed; unsupported attachments remain resolved but inert, and GIF/WebP animation playback is not implemented.
This acceptance does not certify a human accessibility review in a packaged native window.
SYNC-007 host-level uninstall preservation remains separate and open.
